clubs.name: Katy Area Running Club (KARC)
clubs.blurb: 501(c)(3) club for Katy/Cinco Ranch. Track, group runs, Saturday long runs. All ages and abilities.

clubs.name: Good Times Running Co. Run Club
clubs.blurb: Store-run social club in Katy (Villagio). Tuesday beer run and Thursday bagel run energy — all paces welcome.

clubs.name: No Label Running Club
clubs.blurb: FFP-affiliated social club. Weekly runs starting/ending at No Label Brewing. Run, walk, then hang.

clubs.name: Fleet Feet Katy Run Club
clubs.blurb: Free weekly ~3 mile all-paces run/walk from Fleet Feet Katy. No preregistration.

clubs.name: Fleet Feet Sugar Land Run Club
clubs.blurb: Free Wednesday group run/walk from Fleet Feet Sugar Land. All paces, no signup required.

clubs.name: Fort Bend Fit
clubs.blurb: Large Fort Bend training program (half/marathon focus) based near Hwy 6 / Missouri City.

clubs.name: Hardloop Endurance
clubs.blurb: Katy-based endurance coaching and custom plans for goal races.

clubs.name: Houston Harriers
clubs.blurb: Historic competitive club (est. 1975). Hills/track workouts, Saturday long runs at Memorial Park.

clubs.name: HARRA (Houston Area Road Runners Association)
clubs.blurb: Umbrella org for SE Texas running — race series, club network, advocacy, member discounts.

clubs.name: Houston Area Trail Runners (HATS)
clubs.blurb: Trail/ultra community around Houston — group trail runs and ultra support culture.

clubs.name: Karbach Running Club
clubs.blurb: Large social club (~700 members). Thursday evening ~3–3.5 mile run from Karbach Brewing, then hang.

clubs.name: Good Guys Run Club
clubs.blurb: Heights / MKT Trail community social run. Wednesdays ~7 PM along the Heights Highline corridor.

clubs.name: Bayou City Road Runners
clubs.blurb: Inclusive traditional club — group runs and community events around the Heights / Spotts Park area.

clubs.name: Runner's High Club
clubs.blurb: Memorial Park–based training club — Saturday long runs, Tuesday track, Thursday tempo for goal races.

clubs.name: Houston Striders
clubs.blurb: Long-running Houston club with group training and social running culture.

clubs.name: Njord Running
clubs.blurb: Houston run crew mixing competitive training with community/charity focus.

clubs.name: Fleet Feet River Oaks Run Club
clubs.blurb: Monday 6 PM free social run from Fleet Feet River Oaks. Dogs and all paces welcome.

clubs.name: Champions Running Association
clubs.blurb: Nonprofit serving Spring / Klein / Champions / Cypress — walkers through marathon groups.

clubs.name: Bay Area Running Club
clubs.blurb: One of Houston's oldest clubs (NASA roots, est. 1975) serving Clear Lake / Friendswood / League City.

clubs.name: Black Men Run Houston
clubs.blurb: Community run group centered around Memorial Park — fitness, fellowship, and representation.
